item.title: The Appliance Of Specialist Knowledge
item.description: Read The Appliance Of Specialist Knowledge Customer: "Excuse me, I need help with your washing machines." Me: "Sure thing. Let me go get [Coworker], our Appliances specialist." Customer: "No, you can help me." Read The Appliance Of Specialist Knowledge

item.title: We Wouldn’t Want To Be In This Customer’s Shoes…
item.description: Read We Wouldn’t Want To Be In This Customer’s Shoes… Woman: "I need a refund on my kid's shoes." I open the box to see a totally destroyed pair of tennis shoes, our brand's version of a white Converse low top. And by destroyed, I mean the treads were worn down enough if they were tires. Read We Wouldn’t Want To Be In This Customer’s Shoes…

item.title: No Longer Milking This Cash Cow
item.description: Read No Longer Milking This Cash Cow Colleague: "See how he has a quarter-filled gallon of milk?" District Manager: "Yeah?" Colleague: "He's gonna return it, claiming it was rancid. He'll get a brand-new gallon for free. He does this every week." District Manager: "Every… week?! And you allow this?" Read No Longer Milking This Cash Cow

item.title: Paranormal Activi-Tea

item.title: A Definitive Closing Argument
item.description: Read A Definitive Closing Argument I'm locking the doors at closing time (actually, a few minutes AFTER closing time) and, as often happens, a couple comes rushing up. Me: "Sir, ma'am, we're closed." Customer: "Oh, it’s okay! We know what we want!" Read A Definitive Closing Argument
